nodes.label: { app, BrowserWindow, Tray, Menu, dialog, shell }
nodes.norm_label: { app, browserwindow, tray, menu, dialog, shell }

nodes.label: Run as Administrator
nodes.rationale: Required to write the Windows hosts file and to start/stop Windows services.

nodes.label: Archive Section
nodes.rationale: Pre-Docker (plain Windows process) projects kept read-only for their credentials/SSH targets.

nodes.label: Caddy Reverse Proxy (tls internal)
nodes.rationale: Generates data/Caddyfile mapping domain -> localhost:<container port> with automatic local HTTPS.

nodes.label: Commands Panel
nodes.rationale: Saved commands run via 'docker compose exec' in a service or in a WSL shell.

nodes.label: Compose File Discovery
nodes.rationale: Lists compose files in folder and one level below, reads via 'docker compose config'; ports come from compose so there is no port field; one compose project registered once.

nodes.label: Custom .local Domains
nodes.rationale: Domain points to a container port chosen from compose-published ports; sync runs on startup and on project add/edit/delete.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Projects in WSL
nodes.rationale: Start runs 'docker compose up -d' inside WSL so bind mounts/env files resolve as if run manually; Stop keeps containers for fast restart; Down removes containers but keeps volumes. Containers belong to Docker and survive quitting lotwork.

nodes.label: Electron Desktop App + System Tray
nodes.rationale: Closing window only hides to tray so projects keep running; single-instance focuses existing window; server runs inside app so no separate start/stop.

nodes.label: Edit .env Panel (.env + .env.local)
nodes.rationale: .env.local wins on key collisions; badge moves variables between files.

nodes.label: GitHub Panel
nodes.rationale: Requires remote first; git runs inside WSL.

nodes.label: Hosts File Managed Block
nodes.rationale: Entries written inside a '# lotwork-managed-start/end' block so re-syncing is safe.

nodes.label: Language (EN/ID) & Theme Toggle
nodes.rationale: Remembered per browser.

nodes.label: LotWork Self Entry
nodes.rationale: Always shown first and always 'Running' (dashboard visible implies server up); only GitHub panel, since lifecycle is controlled from the app/tray.

nodes.label: Next.js allowedDevOrigins Auto-Patch
nodes.rationale: Adds the domain so the dev server does not block HMR through the Caddy proxy; leaves unrecognized configs (e.g. withPWA) untouched and alerts instead.

nodes.label: Project Cards
nodes.rationale: Status Running / Running n/m / Stopped with expandable panels.

nodes.label: Pull Master Flow
nodes.rationale: checkout master -> pull -> checkout current -> merge -> push; refuses with uncommitted changes; leaves conflicts for manual resolution rather than auto-abort.

nodes.label: Push/Commit Changes Flow
nodes.rationale: Per-file checkboxes with confirmation listing files and branch; default message 'Update'.

nodes.label: Setup.bat Installer
nodes.rationale: One-time setup: installs deps, brands Electron runtime as lotwork.exe so admin prompt/taskbar show lotwork, installs Caddy via winget, creates admin desktop shortcut.

nodes.label: System Services Sidebar
nodes.rationale: MySQL/PostgreSQL as Windows Services with toggles; Node.js/PHP shown as version info only; refreshes every 8s.

nodes.label: WSL 2
nodes.rationale: Projects live in a WSL distro; git and shell commands run inside WSL, not with Windows tooling.

nodes.label: data/projects.json
nodes.rationale: Plain JSON store; data/ not committed since it is machine-specific.
